dogecoin.text:
Week 45 in the cryptocurrency market📈

Cryptocurrency prices were on the rise last week after the election victory of the pro-cryptocurrency Donald Trump. Bitcoin set a new all-time high last week, and the price of Dogecoin rose by almost 80%🚀 (1/3)

#Bitcoin https://t.co/RycO7K2fFy

One of the winners of last week's strong rise has been Dogecoin, which has risen well over 100% in the last 7 days. But unlike Bitcoin, Dogecoin has not yet passed the all-time high of the last bull market👀

#Dogecoin #investing https://t.co/T7p1PCZApQ
